sentences.text: He prays for quashing of the charge sheet dated 22.3.2023.

During the course of hearing, it is not disputed by learned counsel that final report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. submitted by police after completion of investigation is pending consideration before the trial court as the charges against the applicant have not been farmed so far.

Upon hearing the learned counsel and considering his submissions, this Court finds that the stand of the applicant that he performed marriage with victim on 10.3.2023 is not acceptable, for lack of evidence as the marriage certificate (Annexure No.4), does not even contain the parentage of the wife, therefore, the same cannot be construed as a proof of valid marriage.

The reliance placed upon the decision of Mafat Lal's case (Supra) by the learned counsel is also misplaced as in the said case,
the victim herself had filed the petition along with accused seeking quashing of the F.I.R. No. 45 of 2005, wherein the trial pertaining to the co-accused Banna Lal already stood concluded through the judgment of acquittal dated 3.9.2011.

Apart from the above, concededly the final report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. is yet to be considered by the trial court as the charges against the applicant have not been framed so far,
therefore, keeping in view of the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Dharmatma Singh vs.
Harminder Singh & Ors. passed in Criminal Appeal No.1126 of 2011 (3) RCR Criminal 38, this Court is of the considered opinion that the grounds raised by the applicant herein can also be pressed before the trial court at an appropriate stage.
